title: Bitcoin hits 10-month low, hovers above $78,000
text: After sliding even lower throughout January, bitcoin (BTC-USD) is starting the month of February just above $78,000 per token. Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma and Sevens Report Research founder Tom Essaye discuss the crypto asset's downward price trajectory since hitting a record high in October 2025. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid.
